headline: Nvidia pledged $1 billion over five years to support US science, including quantum computing.
score_reason: Large company pledge tied to a federal programme, but spread over five years with no split between new and existing spending.
importance_line: A leading chip maker is promising money and computing power to US researchers, which could speed up work in medicine, energy and quantum for scientists and universities, but it is a company pledge over five years with no breakdown of what is new spending.
summary: Nvidia says it will commit $1 billion over five years to AI-driven science and quantum computing in the United States, supporting university research, American quantum projects and cloud providers that serve government needs. It announced the pledge at a Washington event tied to the Genesis Mission, the federal push to use AI in research, and is also a partner on several of the new Genesis Mission awards.
notes: Company announcement read in full from the NVIDIA newsroom.
